name: RSS / Feed Reader
description: Fetches an RSS or Atom feed and returns the latest items (title, link, date, summary). Lets an agent track a news site, blog, subreddit, or YouTube channel feed for fresh material.

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Fetch an RSS or Atom feed URL and return its latest entries. Great for monitoring trends/news sources. Reddit (add .rss to a subreddit URL) and YouTube channel feeds work too.
